description: List documented OEM replacement parts for one known laptop model. Use once the model is known. Use resolve_request instead first for a vague request. Use get_part or get_part_fits instead when you start from a part number. Use list_models instead to browse models; use get_coverage only to see which part types exist. model accepts a slug or full name; an ambiguous name (e.g. "T14") returns status ambiguous with candidates and no parts — ask the user and call again with the slug; an unknown model is an error result. type keeps only parts of that type, case-insensitive. With neither limit nor cursor, every part is returned; with either, follow next_cursor until null. With 2+ documented screens, panel_options explains how they differ — tell the user to check their current panel's part number or connector. A type with no parts returns parts [] and fit_status no_documented_fit (no document, not incompatibility).

client.description: Optional: your agent or app name (letters and digits), used only for anonymous usage counts.

cursor.description: Optional. The next_cursor value from the previous page, e.g. "25".

limit.description: Optional page size, 1 to 100; default 25, or 50 with view compact.

model.description: Required. Model slug or full name, e.g. "lenovo-thinkpad-t490" or "ThinkPad T490".

view.description: Optional. full (default) includes buy_links and source details; compact keeps part number, type, confidence, lpf_url, constraints, source_url and source_line (the short source sentence for that fit, so a summary can still be re-checked).

name: get_model_parts

fit_status.description: no_documented_fit: there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible. not_asserted: a did-you-mean suggestion; no fit claim is made.

outcome.description: Always present. One field to branch on for every tool: found | no_documented_fit (identified, but no OEM-documented fit; never means incompatible) | needs_clarification (ask the user; see clarifying_question/candidates) | not_found (nothing LPF covers matches). Full contract: /api/states

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

title: Get parts for a model
